title: Saint Alder's Rising
premise: Jude Lockridge has spent twelve years as concierge of the Meridian Hotel in Saint Alder, quietly cataloging every guest, rumor, and lie that passes through its doors. When the diary of Marisol Vane—a woman who vanished in 2013—is found behind a wall during renovation, Jude discovers entries dated years after her disappearance, written in a hand too precise to be forged. As he cross-references the diary against his own obsessive records, he realizes the killer has been feeding false pages into the file to control the investigation, and that the next entry predicts a death dated three days from now. Jude must weaponize his twelve years of observations to set a trap only someone who knows the town's secrets could spring, unmasking the killer as the one person who taught him how to notice everything in the first place.
about_author: Coral Yarrow is the pen name of a former night-desk clerk who spent a decade in small coastal hotels, collecting the stories guests thought no one was listening to. Saint Alder's Rising is her second novel, drawn from a real unsolved disappearance she could never stop filing away.
